name: netdust-agent
description: 0.27.1: the unattended flag — NETDUST_GUARD_ASK=off|0|false|no in the hook's environment (settings `env` or the launching shell) turns the PreToolUse ask tier (rm -rf, force-push, DROP/TRUNCATE, db reset, cache flush) into a logged passthrough; the deny-tier floors are never waived, and an inline prefix on the command string never reaches the hook. Found on the way: a leading `VAR=value` assignment hid any command from the denylist — the command boundary now skips assignments. 0.27.0: the artifact gate — a pass is a property of a file, never a verdict word. gate-check.py --shakeout reads specs/<feature>/shakeout.md: a browser row passes only on `Browser: <post-login url> · shakeout/<name>.png` with a real 1 KB–2 MB PNG under the feature dir, the plan's Layer cell wins over the row's, the WHOLE file is scanned for credentials with no override (shakeout-credential), and a human `Ruling:` is the one accepted exception (shakeout-ruling). The plan side gains four checks: a flagged screen needs a browser row (acceptance-flows), browser rows need `## Shake-out access` (shakeout-access), 'same rail as' needs `## Parity:` with 3+ components read from the RUNNING reference (parity), and a user-facing behaviour cluster's Observable names rendered content, not a 200 (observable-content). loop-check refuses FINISHED on a user-facing behaviour cluster without an `Artifact-diff:` line — ticked boxes are testimony. The cluster panel shrinks to what the week's 15 panels showed actually finds defects: FULL is security-sentinel + invariant-auditor, STANDARD and LIGHT dispatch nobody (the integration gate and the artifact look close the marker), drift joins only the clusters `panel-hints: drift-panel:` names, feature tests are opt-in per cluster (`Feature-tests: yes`) because shakeout-qa now commits every flow it drove as a test, and one fix round per gate — a second is a human ruling or a park. /shakeout is five steps with a human screenshot yield; on WordPress security-sentinel reads netdust-wp's vendored review checklists and cites SEC-nn. 0.26.0: the herdr recipes are VERIFIED, not inferred — run against v0.8.2 and corrected. wait-output returns the pane text in its own result (no second read), a sentinel must be ANCHORED or it matches the echo of the command that produces it, pane read on a fresh pane needs the default source (recent-unwrapped is empty until there is scrollback), and herdr worktree create takes --cwd/--base/--branch/--label. building READS the plan placement instead of re-deriving it — the plan decides where a dispatch runs, gate-check refuses a plan that omits it for 2+ [P] tasks, and the executor places only the three things a plan cannot foresee (a slow gate, a vendor/ bug, a long report). Outside herdr a worktree placement is satisfied by running those tasks in SEQUENCE, which meets the same constraint. the PLAN carries placement and deploy. Reviews, tiers, lanes and batching were already planned; where a dispatch runs was improvised, so gate-check now refuses a cluster with 2+ OPEN [P] tasks and no declared isolation — subagents share the controller working tree, which on 2026-08-09 produced 14 and 17 phantom failures with the rule sitting unread in herdr-moments. A cluster whose [P] tasks are done is never asked. Tasks touching a custom plugin/theme WARN when no ## Deploy block mentions the payload (deploy.payload is a closed list; a missing path deploys as an empty directory a rollback deletes) — a warn, not a fail, because is-this-new is a guess. PLACEMENT. Dispatch answers what runs; placement answers where, and the harness used to skip it — every dispatch became a Task subagent, in your pane, your context, your working tree. Inside herdr, building Stage 2 now places each one: a long gate or suite gets its own pane (same cwd, it only reads), parallel [P] editors and a fix in a vendor/ package get a worktree (a subagent cannot have a different checkout at all), everything else stays a subagent. Outside herdr placement does not exist and behaviour is unchanged. the vendored-package floor — Write/Edit inside vendor/ or node_modules/ now asks, naming why that edit neither survives nor ships (outside deploy.payload, overwritten by the next install) and, for a composer --prefer-source checkout, that the fix belongs in that package own repo. Edit reached NO floor before this: only Write and Bash were inspected. herdr-moments gains the three moments it was missing — a flow verb refusing on a dirty tree, a bug in an imported package, a long gate run. a lane-less tasks.md WARNs — the AC-2 silence is for legacy-waived artifacts only; planning: an older plan in the project is not the grammar. 0.21.1: the stop hook writes memory/ at the project root (walks up from a vendor-tree cwd, never writes under themes/plugins/vendor/packages). Netdust overlay on superpowers — superpowers is the process workhorse (brainstorm, plan, TDD, review, finish); netdust-agent adds the gates: an intake router (class A–F priced by open decisions + a stakes dial), plan-time gates machine-checked by bin/gate-check.py (threat model, invariants, ground-truth, Source: per FR, deliverable-first ordering, behaviour clusters), build-time gates (tier-based testing through the netdust WP harness, review clusters with independent reviewers, feature tests by an independent test-author after each task group), and a self-contained machine layer (hooks + bin/ scripts, bare python3) that verifies artifacts instead of trusting testimony. 0.21 (the inversion): a verification LANE per cluster — `Lane: behaviour` by default (one outside-observable RED for the cluster, bare tasks, no cluster panel, one branch review; the honest lane for CPTs, field maps and services over a framework that already carries the rule), `Lane: contract` by exception (today's per-task grammar), machine-refused only in the unsafe direction (a security-boundary path, high stakes); a model ladder per dispatch kind × lane, measured by run-cost's per-model block; herdr moments (seam tab, worktree isolation, status tab, doorbell, branch-review pane) gated on HERDR_ENV. 0.18 (the re-thinning): 27 skills cut to 6 thin overlays that actually invoke their superpowers base; verify-budget is telemetry, never a HALT; skills ship with evals; and an on-demand convergence gate (/converge) — the codebase read against specs/<feature>/ for what was promised but never built, gaps appended to tasks.md as a PROPOSED phase behind gate-check + the seam.
